newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Diwan to float stake on Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Diwan to float stake on Bourse.

text.p: Morocco's Financiere Diwan, a subsidiary of conglomerate ONA Group, suspended trading prior to flotating a minority stake on the Casablanca bourse, stockbrokers said on Tuesday.

"Financiere Diwan suspended its trading for the second consecutive day...We expect the firm to put up half a million shares on the market for sale to the public," a Casablanca-based stockbroker told Reuters.
One market analyst said George Soros, who owns 13 percent of Diwan, planned to sell nearly half of his stake.
The firm has a capital of 8.23 million shares with a nominal value of 100 dirhams each, the analyst said. The share was last traded at 374 dirhams on May 14.
Diwan's officials were not immediately available for comment.
Among ONA's four listed stocks on the bourse, Diwan showed a 37.3 million dirhams ($4.0 million) net profit in 1996, up from 33.9 million dirhams in the previous year.
Diwan is one of 47 listed firms on the Casablanca stock exchange.
